sentences.text: Hoy Sam hace una visita al señor Mario.
sentences.english: Today Sam pays a visit to Mr Mario.

sentences.text: El señor Mario sigue en la ciudad, en un cuarto cerca del centro.
sentences.english: Mr Mario is still in the city, in a room near the center.

sentences.text: Ayer caminó por el parque, y anoche cenó antes de las siete.
sentences.english: Yesterday he walked in the park, and last night he had dinner before seven.

sentences.text: Sam trae pan y una Biblia.
sentences.english: Sam brings bread and a Bible.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Good morning, Mr Mario.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How is your health?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Better, thank you.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Tomé las pastillas anoche y esta mañana.
sentences.english: I took the pills last night and this morning.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: La tos y la garganta están mejor.
sentences.english: The cough and the throat are better.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: The nose is fine.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: There is no blood.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Good.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Tiene la receta y la cita con el doctor?
sentences.english: Do you have the prescription and the appointment with the doctor?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: The appointment is tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I must take care of my body.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Es un lugar nuevo para mí, pero aquí conocí a una familia buena.
sentences.english: It is a new place for me, but here I met a good family.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Sam, what do you have in your hand?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: A Bible.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: May I read with you?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Of course.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Primero tomá café, y luego leemos.
sentences.english: First have some coffee, and then we read.
Sam reads the Bible.

sentences.text: Es un idioma difícil, pero la palabra de Jesús es fácil de entender.
sentences.english: It is a difficult language, but the word of Jesus is easy to understand.

sentences.text: Aquí está la palabra de Jesús, con las palabras de Sam.
sentences.english: Here is the word of Jesus, in Sam's words.
A shepherd has a hundred sheep.
One is lost.

sentences.text: El pastor tiene a las otras en un lugar bueno.
sentences.english: The shepherd has the others in a good place.

sentences.text: Camina y busca la oveja perdida.
sentences.english: He walks and looks for the lost sheep.
It is late.
It is cold, and it rains.
The shepherd keeps going and going.

sentences.text: Por fin encuentra a la oveja.
sentences.english: At last he finds the sheep.
She is alone.
The shepherd is happy.

sentences.text: La pone sobre su cuerpo y la lleva a la casa.
sentences.english: He puts her on his body and carries her home.

sentences.text: Llama a sus amigos y a sus vecinos.
sentences.english: He calls his friends and his neighbors.
He says to his friends: "I am happy.
She is no longer lost."

sentences.text: Jesús dice: "Hay fiesta entre los ángeles de Dios cuando la gente regresa a Dios."
sentences.english: Jesus says: "There is a party among the angels of God when people return to God."
God forgives.

sentences.text: Dios quiere salvar a todos en el mundo.
sentences.english: God wants to save everyone in the world.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I understood, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: God is like the shepherd.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Yo estuve solo, y Dios me buscó.
sentences.english: I was alone, and God looked for me.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: God loves the world.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: God forgives people.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: My health is a miracle.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: God does miracles.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Dios es el rey del mundo, y es mi rey.
sentences.english: God is the king of the world, and he is my king.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: A good king who saves.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Jesús vino a salvar a la gente.
sentences.english: Jesus came to save people.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Yes, it is a miracle.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: God forgives me.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I have a question, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Where are the others?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Están en un lugar bueno, con el pastor.
sentences.english: They are in a good place, with the shepherd.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: La ciudad es diferente al pueblo.
sentences.english: The city is different from the village.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: There are many good people there.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Anoche sentí frío, pero hoy estoy bien.
sentences.english: Last night I felt cold, but today I am fine.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: The illness is ending.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Mañana es mi último día aquí.
sentences.english: Tomorrow is my last day here.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Afterwards I go back to the village.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Pido a Dios salud para todos.
sentences.english: I ask God for health for everyone.

sentences.text: Ana llega con agua y pan.
sentences.english: Ana arrives with water and bread.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Ana es como un ángel de Dios.
sentences.english: Ana is like an angel of God.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Los ángeles también están felices hoy.
sentences.english: The angels are happy today too.
The three of them pray.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Dios, te alabo en la mañana.
sentences.english: God, I praise you in the morning.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Dios, te adoro con todo el corazón.
sentences.english: God, I worship you with all my heart.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Glory to God.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: God, bless this family.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Alabamos a Dios en la iglesia y en la casa.
sentences.english: We praise God in church and at home.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Adoramos a Dios con la gente.
sentences.english: We worship God with the people.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: God blesses the people.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: The glory is God's.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Praising God is good.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Adorar a Dios es mi vida.
sentences.english: Worshipping God is my life.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: God blesses Mr Mario.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Toda la gloria es para Dios.
sentences.english: All the glory is for God.
Sam finishes the visit.

sentences.text: Regresa a la casa de doña Marta.
sentences.english: He goes back to doña Marta's house.
He is happy and has peace.

sentences.text: Doña Marta cocina sopa y pollo.
sentences.english: Doña Marta cooks soup and chicken.

sentences.text: Sam come con la familia y habla de la visita.
sentences.english: Sam eats with the family and talks about the visit.

sentences.text: Todos están felices, y la casa tiene mucha paz.
sentences.english: Everybody is happy, and the house has a lot of peace.
